title: React / Redux - Webbutvecklare till TaxiCaller i Linköping
description:
Vi söker nu en vass webbutvecklare som vill vara med och utveckla vår mobility as a service-plattform. Om dig Vi söker dig som ständigt håller dig ajour med de senaste teknologierna inom webb-utveckling. Vi söker dig som passar in på följande beskrivning: \* Vass på React, Redux och Ajax. \* Erfarenhet av Node.js.

Dessa innefattar ett trafikledningssystem som körs i realtid på webben, konfigurationssidor och publika sidor. Mer information om oss finner du på: www.taxicaller.com och www.linkedin.com/company/taxicaller

title: Full stack Developer
description:
En fullstack-utvecklare behärskar flera teknologier och programmeringsspråk, vilket gör att de kan arbeta med både klientsidan (frontend) och server-sidan (backend) av en webbapplikation. Det innebär att de kan designa, planera och utveckla webbapplikationer som är funktionella, effektiva och användarvänliga – och som möter både tekniska krav och kundens behov. Fullstack-utvecklare behöver vara kunniga i att implementera säkerhetsprotokoll och hantera datahantering på ett ansvarsfullt sätt. Kompetenser och Ansvarsområden för en Fullstack-utvecklare Som fullstack-utvecklare ansvarar du för att utveckla hela applikationer från början till slut.
  
  

**Detta inkluderar:** Frontend-utveckling: Skapa responsiva och användarvänliga gränssnitt med hjälp av teknologier som HTML, CSS, JavaScript och ramverk som React eller Angular. Backend-utveckling: Utveckla och underhålla server-side logik och databaser, exempelvis genom användning av programmeringsspråk som Python, Java, Ruby eller Node.js samt databashantering med MySQL, MongoDB eller PostgreSQL. Fullständigt arbetsflöde: Designa hela flödet av en webbapplikation, inklusive autentisering, säkerhet, datalagring och kommunikation mellan frontend och backend. Kommunikation med kunder och team: För att skapa effektiva lösningar är det viktigt att förstå och tillgodose kundens behov och önskemål, samt att arbeta nära med andra utvecklare och projektledare.
  
  

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
**Xensam: Join the Future of SAM**
 Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
   

  

 Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we're scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
   

  

 Together, we build the future of SAM.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and evolve the services that power the Xensam platform.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems across a diverse technology landscape. You should enjoy understanding complex systems and contributing across multiple parts of the tech stack where needed. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams, you will deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing solutions that support our continued growth.
   

  

 Beyond development, you will contribute to architectural decisions, improve engineering practices, and help shape the technical direction of the platform. The role offers the opportunity to mentor other engineers, drive technical initiatives, and influence how we build software at scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs
* Build scalable, reliable, and secure systems that support business growth
* Contribute to architecture decisions and technical direction across the platform
* Improve system performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability
* Identify and resolve complex technical challenges across services and integrations
* Refactor and modernize existing solutions in line with engineering best practices
* Write robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
* Participate in code reviews and help maintain high engineering standards
* Collaborate closely with Product, Infrastructure, and Security teams
* Support and mentor other engineers through knowledge sharing and technical guidance


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in backend software development
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and backend architecture
* Experience building scalable, reliable, and secure services
* Strong foundation in software engineering principles, testing, and version control
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL
* Comfortable working with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in fluent English (Swedish is a plus)


**Bonus points if you have**
* Experience with PostgreSQL at scale
* Experience with cloud platforms and containerized environments
* Experience working in high-growth SaaS environments
* Understanding of modern frontend development and frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, Angular)
* Experience collaborating across the full stack to design and deliver user-facing features
* Experience building production systems with Rust


**What You Get**
* A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more
* Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays)
* An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company's success
* A dynamic position embracing freedom under responsibility
* If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip
* Other location-specific benefits


**Our values at Xensam**
 Rebellious
   

  

 We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
   

  

 Humane
   

  

 We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
   

  

 Harmony
   

  

 We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.
   

  

 Xensam is the leading provider of AI-powered Software Asset Management technology. Designed to provide SAM Managers and IT Leaders with valuable data, our platform offers a wealth of features to simplify SAM workloads with built-in automation and advanced functionality. We prioritize ease of use and industry-leading security for both On-premise and Cloud software, putting organizations in total control of their hybrid IT environments.

Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsamamans är vårt motto!

Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

title: Fullstack Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Fullstack Developer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it:
   

  

* The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 3 (Mid-Level). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 68,750 SEK per month + $150,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 75,000 SEK per month + $100,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 81,250 SEK per month + $50,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you know you're suited to a more senior role, don't shrink to fit. Apply to the Senior Fullstack Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. title: AI Engineer
description:
At Umain, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time.  We're on the lookout for developers ready to join us in this journey, bringing passion, creativity, and dedication along with them. The role is ideal for engineers with demonstrable skills in AI as well as for software engineers who have recently transitioned to AI and ML expertise, and offers an opportunity to develop your craft whilst working closely with clients on delivering AI solutions to real-world challenges.
   

  

 We are seeking an AI Engineer with experience in building robust, scaleable, AI powered solutions. The ideal candidate combines a product engineering mindset with a deep enthusiasm for advancing AI capabilities. They demonstrate a great understanding of core AI concepts, product development workflows, and embodies team spirit.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer at Umain, your role will involve:
   

  

* Assisting our clients in clarifying their questions and determining if using AI is a suitable solution for them
* You understand the limitations of a model and how to address them within the product's UX
* Experience architecting agentic solutions (context, memory, and tool/skill handling) and implementing them using frameworks such as Mastra, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain/LangGraph.
* Applying stochastic test casing and trace-based reasoning to evaluate, test, and improve agent behaviour, supported by observability tooling (Langfuse, Promptfoo, etc.).
* Understanding and applying core AI concepts such as redlining, document chunking for accuracy, efficient use of embeddings, and debugging AI systems
* Validating, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining built models, ensuring they can be used at scale
* Developing and maintaining end-to-end data pipelines and machine learning workflows, optimizing for performance and reliability
* Working with diverse, cross-functional teams on projects that deliver groundbreaking AI solutions for global brands


 We also welcome experienced software engineers looking to transition into AI:
   

  

* Strong product development background with +5 years of software engineering experience
* Active engagement in AI (agents, wrappers, context engineering)
* Knows how to work efficiently in a product/engineering team


**Who You Are**
 We value candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Engineer background: 5+ years of professional experience as a software, product, or AI/ML engineer - or equivalent hands-on experience shipping production systems
* Great delivery skills: Proven capability to deliver AI solutions
* Strong AI intuition: A deep understanding of AI concepts
* Curiosity: Enthusiasm for emerging technologies, creativity in problem-solving, and an eagerness to learn in a rapidly evolving AI landscape
* Full-stack product thinking: Frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, with the ability to build end-to-end


 You're a developer with a passion for innovation and a knack for problem-solving, eager to learn and take on new challenges, who values collaboration, diversity, and the opportunity to make a significant impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* A chance to work closely with global brands on a range of diverse and unique projects that explore and truly push the boundaries of what's possible.
* A fun and fair work environment where you have the opportunity to expand your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues.
* A personal coach, and a setting where you can grow professionally and personally.
* Being part of multidisciplinary teams, participating in agile teams, being an important player in a highly ambitious setting.


 Why Umain?
   

  

**Career Framework** 
 : We believe in fairness and clarity, which is why we've established a transparent career framework to ensure equal pay and equal opportunities for all. Your growth and success are as important to us as they are to you. Together with your coach, you will build your own development plan and grow in your career.
   

  

**Work-Life Balance** 
 : At Umain, diversity is our strength. We understand that life doesn't pause when you walk into the office. That's why we've cultivated an environment that supports an excellent work-life balance. We welcome team members from all walks of life, recognizing the richness that different backgrounds, ages, and life stages bring to our team. We're committed to supporting each other, encouraging a healthy work-life balance that respects your needs, whether it's taking care of your family, your pets, or yourself.
   

  

**Innovations and Learning** 
 : Technology is always evolving, bringing new challenges and opportunities for collaboration and learning. Our developers work closely with designers, analysts, testers and more to tackle these challenges head-on, sharing knowledge and growing together.
   

  

**Skills Over Degrees** 
 : We're more interested in what you can do than in the diplomas you hold. Talent, drive, and creativity are what count at Umain. Here, you'll find opportunities to grow, learn, and excel in your career, regardless of your educational background. If you have the ambition and commitment to succeed, we have the environment and resources to support your journey.
   

  

**Background Check:** 
*Umain conducts a background check for final candidates in accordance with our internal policies. The check is carried out only with your consent and is ordered by our CISO through our approved screening partner. The scope of the check depends on the role level. This step is performed late in the recruitment process and is used solely to support a secure and fact-based hiring decision.*
 Umain is a digital product consultancy. We shape, ship and scale digital products at speed. Founded in Stockholm in 2001, we are a growing team of 100+ experts in digital product strategy, design, and technology.

title: Software Engineer - Media
description:
**Meet the Team**
 The Collaboration Technology Group is redefining the future of teamwork, building services that connect people effortlessly across devices, locations and time zones.
   

  

 Our team in Stockholm builds, runs, and continuously improves the core media platform services behind Cisco’s collaboration products, operating at global scale across numerous datacentres. We’re a passionate, collaborative team focused on real-time media reliability, innovation, and engineering excellence.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 As a Software Engineer in our Stockholm Webex Media (WxMedia) & SRE organization, you will bring new real-time media features to life and drive resolution for high-impact media platform escalations. You will combine Site Reliability Engineering practices with real-time media streaming architectures and modern agentic AI (reusable Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM tooling) to transform how we monitor, diagnose, and auto-remediate global media services handling billions of audio and video minutes.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Media Escalations & Real-Time Reliability: Deep-dive troubleshooting for complex WxMedia platform issues, investigating packet loss, jitter, latency, audio/video degradation, and SIP/WebRTC signalling failures across hybrid cloud and bare-metal environments.
* Technical Design & Architecture: Design and implement high-resilience software systems for AI-assisted observability, automated incident response, and self-healing cloud media infrastructure.
* Agentic Workflows & Tooling: Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI agents, MCP tool integrations, and deterministic evaluation pipelines for automated operational decision support.
* Telemetry & Insights: Implement ingestion and correlation pipelines across distributed logs, metrics, OpenTelemetry traces, change events, and runbooks to accelerate Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) and Resolution (MTTR).
* Safe Production Automation: Develop proactive anomaly detection and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) remediation workflows with meticulous safety, security, and quality guardrails.
* Reliability & Scalability Engineering: Partner with application and infrastructure teams to define SLIs/SLOs, handle error budgets, and lead investigation post-incident reviews (PIRs).
* Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor junior engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, establish engineering standards, and drive operational excellence across global development and operations teams.
* Cross-Team Delivery: Manage priorities and timelines, communicate progress clearly, and work across teams to turn production needs into reliable software and AI-assisted capabilities.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree + 8 years of related experience, Master’s + 6 years, or PhD + 3 years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with media streaming or relevant protocols for real-time applications (e.g., RTP/RTCP, SRTP, WebRTC, SIP, SDP, RTSP, or HLS/DASH).
* Experience in some of SRE practices (e.g. SLI/SLO design, observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces), incident management, and automated root cause analysis (RCA))


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Experience with close-to-real-time systems and performance-sensitive code paths.
* Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
* Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.
* Experience building LLM pipelines, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ThousandEyes, or distributed tracing systems.
* Expertise in Terraform/IaC and GitOps/CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
* Experience implementing responsible AI guardrails, deterministic fallback logic, and policy-driven remediation engines.
* Experience with streaming and data platforms (Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/Vector DBs).


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

 CGI växer och vi söker fler erfarna kollegor som vill vara med och utveckla våra uppdrag, kundrelationer och affär inom offentlig sektor.

title: Forskare inom skadeverkan på människa och sjukvårdsbehov
description:
*Söker du en tjänst inom hälsa och sjukvård utöver det normala? Vill du använda dina färdigheter inom anatomi, fysiologi och medicin för att främja beredskap och stödja totalförsvaret? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare!*
**Om tjänsten**
 Ur ett medicinskt perspektiv studerar FOI människan från två perspektiv: vapenverkan och vårdbehov. Det första av dessa perspektiv studerar vilken direkt eller indirekt skadeverkan som åsamkas människor efter bekämpning med något vapensystem, såsom penetrativt och trubbigt våld eller tryckskador. Det andra perspektivet rör vilka vårdinsatser och vårdresurser som krävs för att omhänderta personer som åsamkats sådana skador. Den här tjänsten rör båda dessa perspektiv.
   

  

 FOI utför analyser om, förmedlar metodstöd för, och skapar matematiska modeller av vapenverkan och vårdbehov för såväl den civila som den militära sjukvårdens räkning. Den här tjänsten handlar om att bistå denna verksamhet. Den framgångsrika kandidaten förväntas göra detta på tre sätt: 1. Genom att bedriva forskning inom dessa områden. 2. Genom att bidra med sakkunskap till övriga på myndigheten som arbetar inom dessa områden. Samt 3. Genom att arbeta med att främja att resultat som presteras inom dessa områden nyttas på bästa sätt hos våra slutanvändare (företrädelsevis hälso- och sjukvårdsmyndigheter, regioner och försvarsmyndigheter).
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans i en kompetensintensiv miljö tillsammans med kollegor med företrädelsevis en naturvetenskapligt kvantitativ bakgrund, för att tillsammans möta de utmaningar som våra sjukvårdskedjor och -system kommer att ställas inför i händelse av krig och kris.
   

  

  

**Om enheterna**
 Du kommer att ha hemvist på enheten för befolkningsskydd som tillhör avdelningen försvarsanalys i Kista. Befolkningsskydd är en tillväxtsenhet med inriktning på det civila försvaret och i synnerhet skydd av civilbefolkningen. Därutöver kommer du att stödja enheten för verkansvärdering på avdelningen för vapen skydd och säkerhet.
   

  

  

**Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver?**
**Krav**
* Läkar- eller sjuksköterskelegitimation.
* Fördjupade kunskaper inom en för tjänsten relevant medicinsk disciplin, såsom traumatologi, anatomi eller fysiologi.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Som medicinsk forskare och sakexpert i ett team med en stark bas i modellering och kvantitativa analyser kommer tjänsten att ställa stora krav på vara
 *självgående* 
 , att ha
 *hög samarbetsförmåga* 
 , samt att
 *pedagogiskt* 
 kunna kommunicera komplexa idéer. Vi ser även gärna att du är
 *kreativ* 
 och har en
 *problemlösande analytisk förmåga* 
 , vilket kommer att hjälpa dig att bidra forsknings- och utvecklingsarbetet som bedrivs på myndigheten.
   

  

  

**Meriterande**
* Disputerat inom ett för tjänsten relevant område.
* Kunskaper inom matematisk modellering.
* Erfarenhet av programmering.
* Vana av att arbeta med kvantitativa data.
* Erfarenhet av prehospital sjukvård.


**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**
 Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

  

**Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld?**
 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 18 oktober 2026!
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef David Andersson. Fackliga företrädare är Monia Lougui (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST). Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00.
   

  

 Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten.
   

  

 FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend**
**The Opportunity**
 Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.
   

  

 As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.
   

  

 You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.
   

  

 AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
* Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
* Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
* Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
* Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
* Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
* Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
* Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
* Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
* Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
* Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
* Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
* A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
* A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
* Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
* Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
* An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
* Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
* Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
* Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
* Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
* Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 996,819 - SEK 1,196,182. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.
   

  

 All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer
description:
WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.
   

  

 At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.
   

  

 To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.
   

  

 For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.
   

  

**A few examples of your responsibilities** 
* **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** 
 Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.
* **Start with an LLM.** 
 Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.
* **Prototype and build with AI.** 
 Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.
* **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** 
 Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.
* **Validate and measure.** 
 Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.
* **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** 
 Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.


**What we look for** 
* **Reasoning ability.** 
 Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
* **Drive.** 
 You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
* **Team spirit.** 
 You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
* **Proficiency in English.** 
 You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


**What we offer** 
* **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** 
 You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
* **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** 
 We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
* **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** 
 Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.
* **All. These. Benefits.** 
 Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.


**Commitment & contract**
 Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.
   

  

**Location**
 Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).
   

  

**The selection process**
 In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.
   

  

 Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.
   

  

 All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.
   

  

 We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.
   

  

 We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.
   

  

**Before you apply**
 If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.
   

  

 Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.
   

  

 To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.
   

  

 If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är Solna.
   

  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv.  Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du också tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort. 
   

  





 Mer om att jobba hos oss

**Handlingskraftig**

title: Senior Integration Lead Developer
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vill du vara med i Sveriges vassaste integrations-team? Då är du rätt person för oss! Nu söker vi Dig som vill jobba som Integration Lead Developer på CGI.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig som har ett brinnande intresse för integrationsutveckling på Microsoft-plattformen att börja i ett team som arbetar tätt tillsammans. Normalt sitter vi ihop och arbetar från vårt kontor i Stadshagen. Vi arbetar med spännande kunder i alla branscher vilket gör att du ständigt får nya utmaningar och möjlighet att vidareutvecklas.
   

  

 På CGI strävar vi efter att skapa framgångsrika team som har roligt på jobbet och hjälper varandra att utvecklas. CGI är Sveriges ledande IT-företag och ett av världens största. Detta ger fantastiska karriärmöjligheter och möjlighet till spännande uppdrag. Vårt framgångsrika integrationsteam är som ett eget litet företag inom ramarna för stora CGI vilket ger en stark teamkänsla och samhörighet.
   

  

 CGI är Microsoft Gold Partner inom Application Integration. Vårt integrationsteam i Stockholm går för högvarv och behöver förstärkning. Här får Du möjlighet att jobba med några av de bästa integrationsutvecklarna i branschen!
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

* Utveckla robusta, säkra och återanvändbara integrationslösningar med hjälp av Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, API Management, Event Grid och Azure Functions
* Leda tekniska designdiskussioner, definiera integrationsmönster och bidra till lösningsarkitekturen
* Fungera som teknisk ledare för integrationsprojekt och säkerställa överensstämmelse med affärs- och IT-strategier
* Samarbeta nära med lösningsarkitekter, företagsarkitekter och affärsintressenter
* Mentorera och stödja junior-/mellannivåutvecklare och främja bästa praxis och kodkvalitet
* Driva implementeringen av DevOps och automatiseringsmetoder för integrationspipelines (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code)
* Övervaka integrationsprestanda och proaktivt identifiera förbättringar
* Äga hela livscykeln för integrationer – från kravinsamling till produktionssupport


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* 5 till 8+ års erfarenhet i integrationsutveckling, med stark erfarenhet av att designa och implementera lösningar på Azure iPaas
* Djupgående kunskaper om Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure Functions, Event Grid och hybridanslutningsalternativ
* Bevisad meritlista inom design av API-baserade arkitekturer, eventdrivna flöden och molnbaserade integrationer
* Stark kunskap om autentiseringsmekanismer (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD) och bästa praxis för säkerhet i integrationer
* Kunskaper inom CI/CD-pipelines (helst med Azure DevOps)
* Erfarenhet av övervaknings- och observationsverktyg (t.ex. App Insights, Log Analytics)
* Stark förståelse för integrationsmönster, mikrotjänster och tjänsteorienterad arkitektur (SOA)
* Utmärkta kommunikations-, ledarskaps- och intressenthanteringsfärdigheter
* Kunskap om docker och containers
* Obehindrad svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Meriterande om du också har:
   

  

* Microsoft-certifieringar (t.ex. Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Developer Associate)
* Erfarenhet av att integrera med SAP, Dynamics 365, Salesforce eller andra on-premise system
* Kännedom om BizTalk-migreringar till Azure eller strategier för modernisering av integrationer
* Exponering för dataströmningsplattformar (t.ex. Kafka, Event Hubs)
* Bakgrund inom agila/Scrum-metoder


**Vad du kan förvänta dig av oss:**
 Integrationsteamet på CGI är ett gäng som trivs ihop, delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Här är det lätt att vara sig själv, och det finns alltid någon att bolla idéer med. Ibland gör vi något kul tillsammans efter jobbet, som en spelkväll – bara om man vill, såklart!
   

  

**Låter det intressant?**
 Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! Skicka in din ansökan redan i dag då urvalet sker löpande. Har du frågor om rollen, kontakta gärna rekryterande konsultchef Ramya Parthasarathy, ramya.parthasarathy@cgi.com eller konsultchef Henrik Sjöstedt, henrik,sjostedt@cgi.com.
   

  

**Vad CGI erbjuder dig**
 CGIs kombination av global och lokal närvaro, med kontor på 30 orter i Sverige, ger nöjda kunder men innebär även att du som anställd alltid har ett kontor nära dig. Detta i kombination med flexibla arbetstider ger dig möjlighet till balans mellan privatliv och arbete, oavsett var i livet just du befinner dig.
   

  

 På CGI finns även stora möjligheter till interna karriärvägar där du kan välja att bli specialist inom ditt område, bredda dig inom nya områden eller ta en ledande befattning. Via våra interna nätverk, projekt och åtaganden i globala och nationella industrier, erbjuder vi dig kompetensutveckling och engagerade ledare som stöttar just dig i din utveckling.
   

  

 Mer information om våra förmåner:
   

  

* Aktieprogram och delägarskap: Som delägare har du möjlighet att påverka och i vårt aktieprogram matchar CGI ditt bidrag, krona för krona upp till 3% av din månadslön.
* Friskvårdsbidrag: Vi erbjuder ett årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr.
* Föräldralön: Vi betalar upp till cirka 90% av din lön under den första tiden hemma.
* Trygg anställning: Våra konsulter anställs med kollektivavtal och försäkringar.
* Pensionslösningar: Vi erbjuder attraktiva och förmånliga pensionslösningar.
* Personalbil: Personalbilen används som en privatbil men leasas av CGI.


**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.
   

  

 A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
* Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility
* Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
* Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape
* Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers
* Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience
* Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
* You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
* You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
* You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically.
* Must be located in Sweden


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage
* Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is SEK 1,119,000 - SEK 1,400,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Teknisk testare
description:
Är du en Teknisk testare som brinner för prestandatestning och icke-funktionell testning i komplexa systemlandskap? Nu söker vi dig för kommande konsultuppdrag där du får vara med och säkerställa att affärskritiska systemlösningar inte bara fungerar funktionellt – utan också uppfyller höga krav på prestanda, stabilitet och skalbarhet!
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* 3–7 års erfarenhet av teknisk testning med fokus på icke-funktionella tester (särskilt prestandatestning).
* God förståelse för integrationer, databaser, applikationer och systemarkitektur i komplexa miljöer (både moln och on-prem).
* Erfarenhet av test- och analysverktyg som t.ex. LoadRunner Enterprise SaaS, LoadRunner Virtual Table Server, jMeter, Splunk, Bruno, Fiddler eller Wireshark.
* Erfarenhet av dataformat såsom JSON, XML, CSV och EDIFACT.
* Erfarenhet av eller förståelse för integrationstekniker och protokoll som REST, Kafka, API Gateways, SFTP/FTP och HTTP.
* Förmåga att analysera loggar samt omsätta icke-funktionella krav till konkreta tester.
* Goda kunskaper i engelska i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet från affärssystem och logistikmiljöer såsom ERP-, WMS-, TMS- eller Supply Chain-system.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i större transformations- eller implementationsprojekt.
* Kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift.


**Personlig Profil**
* Analytisk och lösningsorienterad: Du har en stark teknisk problemlösningsförmåga och gillar att dyka djupt i data och systemloggar för att hitta grundorsaker.
* Strukturerad och drivande: Du tar eget ansvar för ditt område, arbetar metodiskt och driver tester framåt från planering till rapportering.
* Samarbetsinriktad: Du trivs i gränssnittet mellan tekniska specialistteam, leverantörer och verksamhetsrepresentanter och är skicklig på att förklara tekniska resultat på ett begripligt sätt.


**Uppdragsfakta**
* Omfattning: Heltid (100 %).
* Placering: Stockholm.
* Startdatum / Längd: Återkommande behov med start enligt överenskommelse.


**Ansvarsområde**
 I rollen som teknisk testare inom icke-funktionell testning spelar du en avgörande roll i storskaliga IT-satsningar. Du arbetar nära utvecklare, arkitekter, tekniska team och leverantörer för att identifiera flaskhalsar och säkerställa hög kvalitet.
   

  

**Dina Huvudsakliga Ansvarsområden**
* Prestanda- & volymtestning: Planera, förbereda och genomföra tester för att validera kapacitet, responstider och mäta prestanda vid olika belastningsscenarier.
* Testdesign & Data: Ta fram testscenarier, testfall och testdata baserat på definierade icke-funktionella krav.
* Analys & Felsökning: Analysera testresultat, loggar och dataflöden för att identifiera flaskhalsar, avvikelser och tekniska risker.
* Samarbete: Samarbeta med arkitekter, infrastrukturspecialister, utvecklings- och testteam kring åtgärder, optimeringar och förbättringar.
* Metodutveckling: Bidra till att etablera och utveckla arbetssätt, processer och testmetoder för icke-funktionell testning.
* Rapportering: Dokumentera resultat samt kommunicera rekommendationer och risker till projektledning och styrgrupp.


 Att vara konsult via Randstad Digital
   

  

 Randstad Digital är din karriärpartner inom IT och digital transformation. Som konsult hos oss får du konkurrenskraftig lön, förmåner och kollektivavtalade villkor. Din konsultchef, som alltid finns nära till hands, ser till att du får varierande och utvecklande uppdrag på olika företag och myndigheter. Som din karriärpartner tillämpar vi vår talangcentrerade strategi som sätter din utveckling i fokus, vilket hjälper dig att uppnå din fulla potential och öppnar upp för nya spännande karriärmöjligheter.

 Randstad Digital är specialiserade inom kompetensområdet IT och är en del av Randstad, en global ledare för talanger med visionen att vara världens mest rättvisa och specialiserade talangföretag. Med huvudkontor i Nederländerna verkar Randstad på 39 marknader och har cirka 40 000 medarbetare. Genom detta globala nätverk i kombination med en stark lokal förankring kan vi erbjuda ett stort utbud av varierande och utvecklande uppdrag och tjänster för dig som är specialist inom IT-området. Som en partner för talanger och genom vår utpräglade specialisering hjälper vi dig att säkra rätt jobb, utveckla relevant kompetens och hitta tillhörighet i arbetslivet.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people in their everyday lives.
   

  

 Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
   

  

 In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
   

  

 By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
   

  

 Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.
   

  

 If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
   

  

 At Odevo, we build production-grade AI systems that change how residential living is managed at scale. Our AI Engineering team is deeply technical, highly collaborative, and driven by learning - and we're now looking for a Product Manager to help shape what we build and why.
   

  

 This is a role at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real-world property management. You'll work side by side with AI engineers, domain experts, and business stakeholders to turn emerging AI capabilities into products that thousands of residents, property managers, and support teams rely on every day. You'll own the product direction for AI-powered features - from early exploration to production - and make sure we're always solving the right problems in the right order.
   

  

 You'll drive the roadmap for tools like our case triage engine - defining what great looks like, gathering user feedback, and working with engineers to continuously improve how we understand and route incoming maintenance issues.
   

  

**Your Main Responsibilities**
* Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a complex case management landscape shaped by decentralized organizations, differing local processes, legacy systems, and uneven technical maturity.
* Own the product direction for AI-powered case management automation, turning ambiguous operational needs into clear priorities, actionable backlog items, and scalable solutions.
* Build deep understanding of how case handling works in practice today across the business - immersing yourself in operational workflows, pain points, and variations to ensure we solve real problems in ways users trust and adopt.
* Act as the bridge between AI engineers, operations teams, domain experts, and business stakeholders - translating between technical possibilities, business needs, and day-to-day operational reality.
* Drive alignment, prioritization, and delivery together with the AI engineering team and stakeholders, balancing business value, technical constraints, data dependencies, and long-term product evolution.
* Drive adoption and measurable impact end to end - from discovery and rollout to follow-up, iteration, and continuous improvement based on usage, feedback, and outcomes.


**Who You Are**
* You thrive in complexity and ambiguity, and you are at your best when bringing structure, focus, and progress to situations that are not yet well defined.
* You are genuinely curious about how work happens in practice and willing to go deep into the domain to understand workflows, edge cases, and operational pain points.
* You build trust quickly and communicate clearly across functions, levels, and backgrounds - from highly technical teams to operational stakeholders and senior leadership.
* You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, balancing short-term needs with long-term direction, and adjusting course as new insights emerge.
* You combine strategic product thinking with hands-on execution, and you care as much about adoption and outcomes as you do about delivery.
* You are excited by applied AI and motivated by the challenge of turning new technology into products that create real value in complex environments.


**What We Are Looking For**
* A true product owner who is the natural go-to person for the AI product domain - perceived as an owner, not a coordinator.
* Someone who can bridge the gap between engineers who care deeply about their craft and stakeholders who care about outcomes.
* A data-driven decision maker who is comfortable making trade-offs and driving alignment across functions.
* An excellent communicator - verbal and written - who can make complex AI concepts accessible to any audience.
* A team player who thrives in a collaborative, open, and supportive environment.


**Relevant Experience**
* 5+ years as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar product leadership role, ideally in B2B SaaS or tech-driven services.
* Hands-on experience working with AI, ML, or data-driven product teams is a strong plus.
* Experience in PropTech or the service industry is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred.
* Fluent in Swedish and English.


**Location**
 Our office is located at Tulegatan 4 in Stockholm, and our AI team follows a hybrid work model with three days in the office to balance focus and collaboration.

 Vi tror på att en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter är nyckeln till att skapa en mer inkluderande och framgångsrik arbetsplats. Därför välkomnar vi alla oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund och etnisk tillhörighet.
   

  

**Bli en del av Coop – Tillsammans gör vi mat-Sverige hållbart!**
 Vill du vara med och utveckla en av Coops viktigaste digitala kundupplevelser?
   

  

 Varje vecka använder hundratusentals kunder Coops digitala kanaler för att planera och genomföra sina matinköp. Nu söker vi en erfaren Produktägare som vill förbättra och vidareutveckla Coop Handla och skapa en smart, smidig och inspirerande och köpupplevelse för kunder över hela Sverige.
   

  

 I rollen får du möjlighet att påverka en central digital produkt med stor betydelse för både användare och affärsresultat. Du blir en nyckelperson i arbetet med att forma framtidens e-handel på Coop.
   

  

***Om Tjänsten***
 Som Produktägare för Coop Handla har du ett helhetsansvar för att leverera coop.se/handla och sätter riktning, prioriteringar och leveranser för kundgränssnittet i samråd med verksamhet. Du skapar förutsättningar för teamet att kontinuerligt leverera värde. Handla-teamet är litet men engagerat.
   

  

 Rollen befinner sig i skärningspunkten mellan affär, teknik och kundupplevelse. Du arbetar nära utvecklare, UX och verksamhet för att säkerställa att vi skapar lösningar och rätt initiativ som träffar målen. Du kommer ha många kontaktytor och även samarbeta tätt med andra team i samma gruppering, bland annat e-com backend (SAP Commerce Cloud), artikelinformation, PIM, app m.fl. team.

title: Head of Go-To-Market (Data & AI)

title: Major Account Manager

title: Customer Success Manager – Infrastruktur och anläggning (bygg)
description:

 Dalux utvecklar innovativa och marknadsledande mjukvarulösningar för bygg- och anläggningsbranschen. Inom infrastruktursegmentet samarbetar vi med ledande entreprenörer, tekniska konsulter och beställare som driver komplexa och samhällskritiska projekt.
   

  

 I rollen som Customer Success Manager ansvarar du för att:
   

  

* Säkerställa en framgångsrik implementering av InfraField hos nya kunder
* Utveckla och fördjupa relationerna med befintliga infrastrukturkunder
* Identifiera affärs- och utvecklingsmöjligheter inom din kundportfölj
* Hålla utbildningar, workshops och ge strategisk rådgivning kopplad till kundernas projekt
* Agera strategisk partner genom hela kundresan
* Representera Dalux på branschevent, mässor och nätverksträffar


 Du arbetar nära kollegorna på Stockholmskontoret samt med support, produktutveckling och övriga Customer Success Managers internationellt.
   

  

**En nyckelroll i vårt fortsatta tillväxt**
 I rollen får du stort mandat och goda möjligheter att påverka arbetssätt, struktur och strategi inom segmentet. Du driver din egen kundportfölj och planerar ditt arbete självständigt – alltid med kundens värdeskapande i centrum.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* Har djup förståelse för arbetsflöden, dokumentation, kvalitetssäkring och digitalisering i större infrastrukturprojekt
* Har arbetat i eller nära produktion, projektledning eller med digitala verktyg
* Har god förståelse för BIM och digitalisering i byggprocessen

* Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska


 Erfarenhet av SaaS-lösningar eller tidigare arbete i Dalux är meriterande, men inget krav.
   

  

**Ta del av succén**
 Du erbjuds en tjänst i en växande organisation där vägen från idé till handling är kort. Med vår nyskapande produktportfölj räds vi inte att kalla oss teknologiska banbrytare. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar nära tillsammans och hjälper varandra i stort som smått. Vår kultur präglas av nytänkande, hjälpsamhet och viljan att göra skillnad – för våra kunder och för varandra.
   

  

 Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Talent Acquisition Specialist, Maja Bøge Jensen, via mbo@dalux.com eller +45 35959165.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan och CV så snart som möjligt – intervjuer hålls löpande.
   

  

**Om Dalux**
 Dalux är en internationell marknadsledare i ständig tillväxt inom mjukvara. Sedan 2005 har vi jobbat för att göra bygg- och fastighetsbranscherna smartare och mer effektiva. Våra användarvänliga BIM-teknologi (3D-informationsmodeller) och digitala verktyg används i dag av ledande entreprenörer, beställare och konsulter i mer än 140 länder. I nära samarbete med våra användare optimerar vi kontinuerligt befintlig teknologi och utvecklar lösningar som bryter ny mark. Under de senare åren har vi presenterat flera världsnyheter; bland annat världens snabbaste BIM-viewer och BIM-baserad.

 As soon as possible

title: Senior Product Manager - Audiobooks Format Foundations

 Arbetsgivare Randstad AB
